children: Parks! America, through subsidiary Wild Animal Safari - Georgia, refinanced its debt with a $1.30 million term loan from Cendera Bank dated Aug. 26, 2026, and subsequently locked a fixed 7.35% rate via a Rate Conversion Agreement with SouthState Bank on Sep. 8, 2026. The new loan carries a 25-year amortization, matures Sep. 1, 2033 with a balloon payment, and initially priced at CME 1-month SOFR plus 2.70%. Proceeds were used to fully repay and terminate the company’s 2021 Synovus Bank term loan. Management expects the refinancing and fixed-rate conversion to enhance visibility on interest costs and align covenants with operations.

: Secured seven-year term loan with 25-year amortization and balloon
: Refinance prior Synovus term loan and support operations
Agreement 2: Parks! America Fixes 2026 Term Loan at 7.35% Via Rate Conversion With SouthState Bank

: SouthState Bank, ARC Fixed Rate Provider
: Lock in fixed rate and reduce interest-rate risk
